description: A relatively gentle 30 minute hike to Goose Lake. The trail is accessed through Morton Lake Provincial Park.
directions: Heading north from Campbell River, turn left onto Menzies Mainline for 16kms following the signs to Morton Lake Provincial Park. Day use parking is available in the park. The trail head is located along the back side of Morton Lake between designated campsites.

stats.Closure:
This trail is closed for safety reasons, effective immediately, until further notice.
